title: Streaming counters that go down as well as up
policy: P2: repeated records of one operation are cumulative snapshots; each field counts its largest value, so totals never go down. Using the last record (180) or the first (350) are the alternatives.
derivation: input max(100,90,100) = 100; output max(50,120,80) = 120; cache read max(200,200,0) = 200. 420 tokens, one operation.
